tailoring.headline: Experienced Ecommerce Java/Spring Boot Microservices Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and building microservices. Proven record designing and implementing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, data pipelines, and headless commerce solutions. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and production support. Techno-functional consultant experienced in requirements analysis, user stories, and stakeholder collaboration. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Experienced Ecommerce Java/Spring Boot Microservices
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Wipro’s ecommerce practice, renowned for driving digital commerce at scale. With over 5 years building SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot microservices and headless commerce that aligns perfectly with your vision.

bullets.label: **Integration Architecture**
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and ERP/MDM integrations, ensuring seamless product data flow across global channels.

bullets.label: **API Development**
bullets.text: Built robust OCC REST web services and micro-service APIs, enabling headless storefronts and third-party consumption.

bullets.label: **Microservices & Cloud**
bullets.text: Implemented Java/Spring Boot microservices, containerized with Docker and orchestrated on Kubernetes, supporting scalable ecommerce workloads.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Leadership**
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs, and delivered solutions within agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work.

tailoring.why_company: Wipro’s reputation as a global leader in digital transformation and its ambitious ecommerce portfolio inspire me. I admire how Wipro combines cutting-edge technology with deep industry expertise to help clients scale commerce platforms. Joining a team that drives innovative Java/Spring-Boot microservice solutions aligns with my passion for building high-performance, headless ecommerce systems and offers the opportunity to contribute to impactful, large-scale projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help Wipro deliver scalable, headless ecommerce solutions, driving innovation and client success.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years in Java/Spring-Boot microservices. I’m eager to bring my integration and headless commerce experience to Wipro’s ecommerce team. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Experienced Ecommerce Java/Spring Boot Microservices Role
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Experienced Ecommerce Java/Spring Boot Microservices position at Wipro. With over five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer strong Java, Spring Boot, API and integration expertise. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and will be available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.
